colophon.en: An account of the people of Nephi, according to his record.
colophon.sm: O se tala o le nuu o Nifae, e tusa ma lana talafaamaumau.

heading.en: The Nephites and the Lamanites are all converted unto the Lord—They have all things in common, work miracles, and prosper in the land—After two centuries, divisions, evils, false churches, and persecutions arise—After three hundred years, both the Nephites and the Lamanites are wicked—Ammaron hides up the sacred records. About A.D. 35–321.
heading.sm: Ua faaliliuina uma sa Nifaē ma sa Lamanā i le Alii—Ua tutusa pau i latou i mea uma, fai vavega, ma manuia i le laueleele—Ina ua mavae le lua seneturi, sa oo ina tutupu a'e fevaevaeaiga, mea leaga, ekalesia pepelo, ma sauaga—Ina ua mavae le tolu selau tausaga, sa oo ina amioleaga uma sa Nifaē ma sa Lamanā—Ua natia e Amorona talafaamaumau paia. E tusa o le 35–321 T.A.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the thirty and fourth year passed away, and also the thirty and fifth, and behold the disciples of Jesus had formed a church of Christ in all the lands round about. And as many as did come unto them, and did truly repent of their sins, were baptized in the name of Jesus; and they did also receive the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mavae atu le tausaga e tolusefulu ma le fa, ma le tolusefulu ma le lima foi, ma faauta sa faatuina e soo o Iesu se ekalesia a Keriso i laueleele atoa o faataamilo ai. Ma o le toatele o i latou na o mai ia te i latou, ma le salamo moni ia latou agasala, sa papatisoina i le suafa o Iesu; ma sa latou maua foi le Agaga Paia.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the thirty and sixth year, the people were all converted unto the Lord, upon all the face of the land, both Nephites and Lamanites, and there were no contentions and disputations among them, and every man did deal justly one with another.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le tausaga e tolusefulu ma le ono, sa liua tagata uma i le Alii, i le laueleele atoa, o sa Nifaē uma ma sa Lamanā, ma sa leai ni finauga ma ni feteenaiga i totonu ia te i latou, ma sa faamaoni tagata taitasi uma o le tasi i le isi i fealoaiga na latou fai.

verses.en: And they had all things common among them; therefore there were not rich and poor, bond and free, but they were all made free, and partakers of the heavenly gift.
verses.sm: Ma sa tutusa pau i latou i mea uma o i totonu ia te i latou; o lea sa leai se mauoa ma se mativa, pologa ma se saoloto, ae sa tuusaoloto i latou uma, ma faatofutofusia i le meaalofa faalelagi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the thirty and seventh year passed away also, and there still continued to be peace in the land.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mavae atu foi le tausaga e tolusefulu ma le fitu, ma sa i ai pea lava le filemu i le laueleele.

verses.en: And there were great and marvelous works wrought by the disciples of Jesus, insomuch that they did heal the sick, and raise the dead, and cause the lame to walk, and the blind to receive their sight, and the deaf to hear; and all manner of miracles did they work among the children of men; and in nothing did they work miracles save it were in the name of Jesus.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai galuega tetele ma le ofoofogia na faia e soo o Iesu, sa oo ina latou faamalolo ma’i, ma faatutu mai e ua oti, ma faasavavali e na pipili, ma faapupula i e na tauaso, ma e na tutuli ina ia faalogo; ma sa latou faia vavega uiga eseese uma i totonu o le fanauga a tagata; ma sa leai se mea sa latou faia ai vavega vagana ai i le suafa o Iesu.

verses.en: And thus did the thirty and eighth year pass away, and also the thirty and ninth, and forty and first, and the forty and second, yea, even until forty and nine years had passed away, and also the fifty and first, and the fifty and second; yea, and even until fifty and nine years had passed away.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona mavae atu o le tausaga e tolusefulu ma le valu, e faapea foi ma le tolusefulu ma le iva, ma le fasefulu ma le tasi, ma le fasefulu ma le lua, ioe, seia oo lava ina mavae atu le fasefulu ma le iva o tausaga, e faapea foi ma le limasefulu ma le tasi, ma le limasefulu ma le lua; ioe, ma seia oo lava ina mavae atu le limasefulu ma le iva o tausaga.

verses.en: And the Lord did prosper them exceedingly in the land; yea, insomuch that they did build cities again where there had been cities burned.
verses.sm: Ma sa faamanuiaina tele i latou e le Alii i le laueleele; ioe, sa oo ina latou toe fausia ni aai i mea sa i ai aai na mu.

verses.en: Yea, even that great city Zarahemla did they cause to be built again.
verses.sm: Ioe, e oo lava i lena aai tele o Saraʼemila sa latou faia ina ia toe fausia.

verses.en: But there were many cities which had been sunk, and waters came up in the stead thereof; therefore these cities could not be renewed.
verses.sm: Peitai sa i ai le tele o aai sa gogoto, ma sa alu ae le vai ma ua lofia mea na i ai; o lea sa le mafai ai ona toe faafouina ia aai.

verses.en: And now, behold, it came to pass that the people of Nephi did wax strong, and did multiply exceedingly fast, and became an exceedingly fair and delightsome people.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, sa oo ina faasolo malolosi le nuu o Nifae, ma matua faatoateleina vave, ma avea ma ni tagata lalelei tele ma tauagafau.

verses.en: And they were married, and given in marriage, and were blessed according to the multitude of the promises which the Lord had made unto them.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou faaipoipo, ma tuuina atu ia faaipoipoina, ma sa faamanuiaina e tusa ma le tele o folafolaga na faia e le Alii ia te i latou.

verses.en: And they did not walk any more after the performances and ordinances of the law of Moses; but they did walk after the commandments which they had received from their Lord and their God, continuing in fasting and prayer, and in meeting together oft both to pray and to hear the word of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou le toe savavali e tusa ma tu ma sauniga o le tulafono a Mose; ae sa latou savavali e tusa ma poloaiga na latou maua mai lo latou Alii ma lo latou Atua, ma ola ai pea i le anapogi ma le tatalo, ma i le potopoto soo faatasi e tatalo ma faalogologo i le afioga a le Alii.

verses.en: And it came to pass that there was no contention among all the people, in all the land; but there were mighty miracles wrought among the disciples of Jesus.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina leai se finauga i totonu o le nuu atoa, i le laueleele atoa; ae sa i ai vavega tetele na faia e soo o Iesu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the seventy and first year passed away, and also the seventy and second year, yea, and in fine, till the seventy and ninth year had passed away; yea, even an hundred years had passed away, and the disciples of Jesus, whom he had chosen, had all gone to the paradise of God, save it were the three who should tarry; and there were other disciples ordained in their stead; and also many of that generation had passed away.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mavae atu le tausaga e fitusefulu ma le tasi, ma le tausaga foi e fitusefulu ma le lua, ioe, ma i se aotelega, seia oo ina mavae atu le fitusefulu ma le iva o tausaga; ioe, e oo i le selau o tausaga sa mavae atu, ma ua o atu uma soo o Iesu, o e na ia filifilia, i le parataiso o le Atua, vagana ai lava le toatolu o e o nonofo pea; ma sa i ai isi soo sa faauuina e suitulaga ia te i latou; ma sa toatele foi i latou o lena tupulaga ua maliliu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that there was no contention in the land, because of the love of God which did dwell in the hearts of the people.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina leai se finauga i le laueleele, ona o le alofa o le Atua sa mau i loto o tagata.

verses.en: And there were no envyings, nor strifes, nor tumults, nor whoredoms, nor lyings, nor murders, nor any manner of lasciviousness; and surely there could not be a happier people among all the people who had been created by the hand of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa leai se matau’a, po o ni feeseeseaiga, po o ni vevesi, po o ni faitaaga, po o ni pepelo, po o ni fasioti tagata, po o soo se uiga tuinanau; ma e moni e le mafai ona i ai o ni tagata e sili atu ona fiafia i totonu o tagata uma na foafoa e le aao o le Atua.

verses.en: There were no robbers, nor murderers, neither were there Lamanites, nor any manner of -ites; but they were in one, the children of Christ, and heirs to the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Sa leai ni faomea, po o ni fasioti tagata, sa leai ni sa Lamanā, po o soo se ituaiga o tagata; ae sa tasi i latou, o le fanau a Keriso, ma o suli i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: And how blessed were they! For the Lord did bless them in all their doings; yea, even they were blessed and prospered until an hundred and ten years had passed away; and the first generation from Christ had passed away, and there was no contention in all the land.
verses.sm: Ma sa faamanuiaina tele lava i latou! Aua sa faamanuiaina i latou e le Alii ia latou mea uma na fai; ioe, sa faamanuiaina lava ma faauluolaina i latou seia oo ina mavae atu le selau ma le sefulu o tausaga; ma sa oo ina mavae atu le tupulaga muamua mai ia Keriso, ma sa leai se finauga i le laueleele atoa.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Nephi, he that kept this last record, (and he kept it upon the plates of Nephi) died, and his son Amos kept it in his stead; and he kept it upon the plates of Nephi also.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina maliu Nifae, o ia o lē na tusia lenei talafaamaumau, (ma sa ia tusia i luga o papatusi a Nifae), ma sa tusia ai lea e lona atalii o Amosa e suitulaga ia te ia; ma sa tusia foi e ia i luga o papatusi a Nifae.

verses.en: And he kept it eighty and four years, and there was still peace in the land, save it were a small part of the people who had revolted from the church and taken upon them the name of Lamanites; therefore there began to be Lamanites again in the land.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia tusia i tausaga e valusefulu ma le fa, ma sa i ai pea le filemu i le laueleele, vagana ai se vaega toaitiiti o le nuu o e na fouvale mai i le ekalesia ma latou ave i o latou luga le igoa o sa Lamanā; o lea na amata ai ona toe i ai o sa Lamanā i le laueleele.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Amos died also, (and it was an hundred and ninety and four years from the coming of Christ) and his son Amos kept the record in his stead; and he also kept it upon the plates of Nephi; and it was also written in the book of Nephi, which is this book.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina maliu foi Amosa, (ma o le selau ivasefulu ma le fa lea o tausaga mai le afio mai o Keriso) ma sa tusi e lona atalii o Amosa le talafaamaumau e suitulaga ia te ia; ma sa ia tusia foi i luga o papatusi a Nifae; ma sa tusia foi i le tusi a Nifae, le tusi lava lenei.

verses.en: And it came to pass that two hundred years had passed away; and the second generation had all passed away save it were a few.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua mavae atu le lua selau o tausaga; ma sa mavae atu uma le tupulaga lona lua vagana ai sina toaitiiti.

verses.en: And now I, Mormon, would that ye should know that the people had multiplied, insomuch that they were spread upon all the face of the land, and that they had become exceedingly rich, because of their prosperity in Christ.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, o a’u, o Mamona, ou te manao ia outou iloa sa faatoateleina le nuu, sa oo ina latou salalau atu i le laueleele atoa, ma ua avea i latou ma ni tagata mauoa tele, ona o lo latou manuia ia Keriso.

verses.en: And now, in this two hundred and first year there began to be among them those who were lifted up in pride, such as the wearing of costly apparel, and all manner of fine pearls, and of the fine things of the world.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, i le tausaga lenei e lua selau ma le tasi, sa amata ona i ai i totonu o i latou ni isi o e sa faafefeteina i le faamaualuga, i mea e i ai le ofuina o ofu taugata, ma ituaiga eseese uma o penina taua, ma mea matagofie o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And from that time forth they did have their goods and their substance no more common among them.
verses.sm: Ma e amata mai lena taimi ma agai atu i le lumanai ona latou le toe tutusa pau i a latou oloa ma a latou meatotino i totonu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And they began to be divided into classes; and they began to build up churches unto themselves to get gain, and began to deny the true church of Christ.
verses.sm: Ma sa amata ona vaevaeina o i latou i ni vasega; ma sa amata ona latou faatutuina o ni ekalesia mo i latou lava ia maua ai le oa, ma amata ona latou faafitia le ekalesia moni a Keriso.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when two hundred and ten years had passed away there were many churches in the land; yea, there were many churches which professed to know the Christ, and yet they did deny the more parts of his gospel, insomuch that they did receive all manner of wickedness, and did administer that which was sacred unto him to whom it had been forbidden because of unworthiness.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mavae atu le lua selau ma le sefulu o tausaga, e tele ekalesia ua i ai i le laueleele; ioe, e tele ekalesia sa fai mai ua latou iloa le Keriso, ae peitai sa latou teena vaega e tele o lana talalelei, sa oo ina latou talia ituaiga amioleaga eseese uma, ma latou avatu lena mea ua paia ia te ia o lē na faasaina ona o le lē agavaa.

verses.en: And this church did multiply exceedingly because of iniquity, and because of the power of Satan who did get hold upon their hearts.
verses.sm: Ma sa matua faatoateleina tele lenei ekalesia ona o le amioletonu, ma ona o le mana o Satani, o lē na umia o latou loto.

verses.en: And again, there was another church which denied the Christ; and they did persecute the true church of Christ, because of their humility and their belief in Christ; and they did despise them because of the many miracles which were wrought among them.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, sa i ai foi se tasi ekalesia na faafitia le Keriso; ma sa latou sauaina le ekalesia moni a Keriso, ona o lo latou lotomaualalalo ma lo latou talitonu ia Keriso; ma sa latou inosia i latou ona o le tele o vavega sa faia ia te i latou.

verses.en: Therefore they did exercise power and authority over the disciples of Jesus who did tarry with them, and they did cast them into prison; but by the power of the word of God, which was in them, the prisons were rent in twain, and they went forth doing mighty miracles among them.
verses.sm: O lea sa latou faatino ai le mana ma le pule i luga o soo o Iesu o e na nonofo faatasi ma i latou, ma sa latou lafo i latou i totonu o le falepuipui; peitai sa vaeluaina falepuipui ona o le mana o le afioga a le Atua, lea sa ia i latou, ma latou o atu ma faia vavega tetele i totonu o i latou.

verses.en: Nevertheless, and notwithstanding all these miracles, the people did harden their hearts, and did seek to kill them, even as the Jews at Jerusalem sought to kill Jesus, according to his word.
verses.sm: Ae ui i nei vavega uma, sa faamaaa e tagata o latou loto, ma saili e fasioti i latou, e pei ona sa saili tagata Iutaia i Ierusalema e fasioti ia Iesu, e tusa ma lana fetalaiga.

verses.en: And they did cast them into furnaces of fire, and they came forth receiving no harm.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou lafo i latou i totonu o ogaumu o afi, ma sa latou o mai i fafo e lei afaina ai.

verses.en: And they also cast them into dens of wild beasts, and they did play with the wild beasts even as a child with a lamb; and they did come forth from among them, receiving no harm.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou lafo foi i latou i totonu o lua o manu feai, ma sa latou taaalo ma manu feai e pei lava o taaalo se tamaitiiti ma se tamai mamoe; ma sa latou o mai i fafo mai totonu o i latou, e lei afaina ai.

verses.en: Nevertheless, the people did harden their hearts, for they were led by many priests and false prophets to build up many churches, and to do all manner of iniquity. And they did smite upon the people of Jesus; but the people of Jesus did not smite again. And thus they did dwindle in unbelief and wickedness, from year to year, even until two hundred and thirty years had passed away.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa faamaaa e tagata o latou loto, ona sa ta’ita’ia i latou e faitaulaga ma perofeta pepelo e toatele e atia’e ekalesia e tele, ma faia ituaiga o amioletonu eseese uma. Ma sa latou taia tagata o Iesu; peitai o tagata o Iesu sa le toe taia atu. Ma sa faapea ona faaitiitia i latou i le lē talitonu ma le amioleaga, mai lea tausaga i lea tausaga, seia oo ina mavae atu le lua selau ma le tolusefulu o tausaga.

verses.en: And now it came to pass in this year, yea, in the two hundred and thirty and first year, there was a great division among the people.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo i lenei lava tausaga, ioe, le tausaga lea e lua selau tolusefulu ma le tasi, sa i ai se fevaevaeaiga tele i totonu o le nuu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that in this year there arose a people who were called the Nephites, and they were true believers in Christ; and among them there were those who were called by the Lamanites—Jacobites, and Josephites, and Zoramites;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tutulai ae i le tausaga lenei ni tagata sa ta’ua o sa Nifaē, ma o i latou ia o tagata talitonu moni ia Keriso; ma i totonu o i latou sa i ai e sa ta’ua o sa Lamanā— o sa Iakopō, ma sa Iosefā, ma sa Soramā;

verses.en: Therefore the true believers in Christ, and the true worshipers of Christ, (among whom were the three disciples of Jesus who should tarry) were called Nephites, and Jacobites, and Josephites, and Zoramites.
verses.sm: O lea o tagata talitonu moni ia Keriso, ma tagata tapuai moni ia Keriso, (ia sa i ai i totonu o i latou ia soo e toatolu o Iesu o e na nonofo pea) sa ta’ua o sa Nifaē, ma sa Iakopō, ma sa Iosefā, ma sa Soramā.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they who rejected the gospel were called Lamanites, and Lemuelites, and Ishmaelites; and they did not dwindle in unbelief, but they did wilfully rebel against the gospel of Christ; and they did teach their children that they should not believe, even as their fathers, from the beginning, did dwindle.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ta’ua i latou o e na teena le talalelei o sa Lamanā, ma sa Lemuelū, ma sa Isamaelī; ma sa le faaitiitia i latou i le le talitonu, ae sa latou fouvale ma le loto i ai e faasaga i le talalelei a Keriso; ma sa latou a’oa’o a latou fanau ia latou le talitonu, e pei lava o o latou tamā, mai le amataga, sa faaitiitia lava.

verses.en: And it was because of the wickedness and abomination of their fathers, even as it was in the beginning. And they were taught to hate the children of God, even as the Lamanites were taught to hate the children of Nephi from the beginning.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo mai lena mea ona o le amioleaga ma mea inosia a o latou tamā, e pei lava ona sa i ai i le amataga. Ma sa a’oa’oina i latou ia inoino i fanau a le Atua, e pei ona sa aoaoina sa Lamanā mai le amataga ia inoino i fanau a Nifae.

w.en: even as it was in the beginning.

verses.en: And it came to pass that two hundred and forty and four years had passed away, and thus were the affairs of the people. And the more wicked part of the people did wax strong, and became exceedingly more numerous than were the people of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mavae atu le lua selau fasefulu ma le fa o tausaga, ma sa faapea foi i tulaga o le nuu. Ma sa faasolo malolosi ma sili atu ona toatele le vaega sili ona amioleaga o le nuu nai lo tagata o le Atua.

verses.en: And they did still continue to build up churches unto themselves, and adorn them with all manner of precious things. And thus did two hundred and fifty years pass away, and also two hundred and sixty years.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou atia’e pea ekalesia mo i latou lava, ma teuteu i latou i mea taua uiga eseese uma. Ma sa faapea ona mavae atu o le lua selau ma le limasefulu o tausaga, ma le lua selau ma le onosefulu foi o tausaga.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the wicked part of the people began again to build up the secret oaths and combinations of Gadianton.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata e le vaega amioleaga o tagata ona toe faatutuina tautoga ma faalapotopotoga faalilolilo a Katianetona.

verses.en: And also the people who were called the people of Nephi began to be proud in their hearts, because of their exceeding riches, and become vain like unto their brethren, the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ma o tagata foi o e sa ta’ua o le nuu o Nifae ua amata ona faamaualuluga i o latou loto, ona o a latou oa e tele, ma ua fiasili e pei o o latou uso, o sa Lamanā.

verses.en: And from this time the disciples began to sorrow for the sins of the world.
verses.sm: Ma mai i lenei taimi sa amata ona faanoanoa soo ona o agasala a le lalolagi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when three hundred years had passed away, both the people of Nephi and the Lamanites had become exceedingly wicked one like unto another.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua mavae atu le tolu selau o tausaga, sa matua amioleaga tele lava tagata uma o le nuu o Nifae ma sa Lamanā ua faapei lava le tasi o le isi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the robbers of Gadianton did spread over all the face of the land; and there were none that were righteous save it were the disciples of Jesus. And gold and silver did they lay up in store in abundance, and did traffic in all manner of traffic.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina salalau atu le au faomea a Katianetona i luga o le laueleele uma; ma sa leai ni isi sa amiotonu vagana ai soo o Iesu. Ma sa latou teuina auro ma ario e matuā tele lava, ma sa latou fefaatauai i ituaiga o fefaatauaiga eseese uma.

verses.en: And it came to pass that after three hundred and five years had passed away, (and the people did still remain in wickedness) Amos died; and his brother, Ammaron, did keep the record in his stead.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua mavae atu tausaga e tolu selau ma le lima, (ma sa tumau pea tagata i le amioleaga) sa maliu Amosa; ma o lona uso, o Amorona, sa tausia talafaamaumau e suitulaga ia te ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when three hundred and twenty years had passed away, Ammaron, being constrained by the Holy Ghost, did hide up the records which were sacred—yea, even all the sacred records which had been handed down from generation to generation, which were sacred—even until the three hundred and twentieth year from the coming of Christ.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua mavae atu tausaga e tolu selau ma le luasefulu, o Amorona, ina ua uunaia o ia e le Agaga Paia, sa ia natia mau talafaamaumau ia ua paia— ioe, talafaamaumau paia uma lava ia sa tuulima faasolo mai lea tupulaga i lea tupulaga, ia ua paia— seia oo mai lava i le tausaga e tolu selau ma le luasefulu mai le afio mai o Keriso.

verses.en: And he did hide them up unto the Lord, that they might come again unto the remnant of the house of Jacob, according to the prophecies and the promises of the Lord. And thus is the end of the record of Ammaron.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia natia mau i latou mo le Alii, ina ia mafai ona toe oo mai i latou i le vaega o totoe o le aiga o Iakopo, e tusa ma valoaga ma folafolaga a le Alii. Ma o le faaiuga lea o le talafaamaumau a Amorona.
